hook.name: UniFunToken
hook.description: ERC-404 token/hook combined: afterSwap collects a 4% fee on ETH/UFUN swaps via afterSwapReturnsDelta. On buys, the fee accrues to the creator as tokens; on sells, 1% ETH royalty goes to the creator and 3% ETH is distributed as dividends to non-exempt token holders. Whole-token holders receive mintable on-chain pixel NFTs.
